tracks_the_gain_and_losses_of_the_exchan: Tracks the gain and losses of the exchange differences.
when_customers_pay_in_advance_for_produc: When customers pay in advance for products/services.
money_that_has_been_borrowed_from_a_cred: Money that has been borrowed from a creditor.
tracks_the_direct_cost_of_the_goods_sold: Tracks the direct cost of the goods sold.
inventory_asset_description: An account that holds valuation of products or goods that available for sale.
opening_balance_difference_description: This account holds the difference between debits and credits entered during the opening balance.
retained_earnings_description: Retained earnings tracks net income from previous fiscal years.
opening_balance_equity_description: When you enter opening balances to the accounts, the amounts enter in opening balance equity. This keeps your trial balance correct without entering the second side of the entry.
cost_of_goods_sold_description: Goods purchased with the intention of selling these to customers.
bank_fees_and_charges_description: Any bank fees levied are recorded here: account maintenance fees, transaction charges, late payment fees and the like.
other_income_description: Income that is not associated with the core business.
